lines.en: When I step, the grass bends backward.
I do not weave when I chase.

lines.zh: 脚步声和你的一模一样。
lines.en: My steps sound exactly like yours.
The ground darkens under my feet.

lines.zh: 我保持这个速度，刚好够追。
lines.en: I hold this pace; it's just enough to catch you.
I am a little faster than you.
I do not shout. I run.
I run at your heel.
I never get winded.
The road shortens as I pass.
My red glows in the dark.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟的声音我学得很像。
lines.en: I have your footfall down exactly.
I have stopped. Not far off.

lines.zh: 我站在拐角，鞋尖朝向你的路。
lines.en: I stand at the corner, toes pointed down your road.
I know you will tire.
I am in no rush to catch you.

lines.zh: 我在数你走几步会回头。
lines.en: I am counting when you will look back.
I am at your back; run faster.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚步慢下来。
lines.en: I wait for your steps to slow.
I am not out of breath.
Go on a little further.

lines.zh: 脚步声停了，那是我的意思。
lines.en: The footsteps stopped. That was my doing.

lines.zh: 我在你听不到的地方等。
lines.en: I wait where you cannot hear me.
I am never in a hurry.
This stretch is mine already.
My steps stop behind you.

lines.zh: 你回头时，红眼正对着你。
lines.en: When you turn, red eyes meet yours.
In a chase, your steps are too slow.
Run now.
I do not intend to stop.
The way you're running leads straight to me.
I like this distance.
Do you hear my shoes?
I am inside your shadow.
Do not stop.
You are breathing too loudly.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直在你背上。
lines.en: My eyes never leave your back.
It does not matter where you run.

lines.zh: 我在这个世界的边缘等你。
lines.en: I wait at the world's edge.

lines.zh: 你回头一次，我就近一步。
lines.en: Every glance brings me a step closer.
I cleared this road beforehand.

lines.zh: 你的手在墙上摸不到门。
lines.en: Your hand finds no door on the wall.

lines.zh: 我只让你的名字在风里响。
lines.en: I only let your name sound in the wind.
Your steps have come apart.

lines.zh: 你选的那条路，尽头是死墙。
lines.en: The road you chose ends at a dead wall.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸已经乱成一段。
lines.en: Your breathing has broken into fragments.
I am struck, and still running.
I need not stop.

lines.zh: 追你的时候，我没有实体。
lines.en: Chasing you, I have no body.

lines.zh: 这一下没让我减速半分。
lines.en: That blow didn't slow me a bit.
That hardly matters.
I am not slowed.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，只剩红色的雾。
lines.en: Where you struck, only red mist remains.
Do you hear me laugh?
I will keep running.
You get one of those.
Do not stop for that.
That is wasted time.
I have no use for those.
You look good when you stop.
Keep running. Do not look back.
You will drop what you carry.
I eat nothing.
There is much more road.
Do not look that way.
Running is the interesting part.
Hit me and you stop.
I am always this close.
Your shoulder meets air.
I gave one step.
Then I am close again.
You should not have stopped.
My body is cold.

lines.zh: 你越跑，那声音跟得越紧。
lines.en: The more you run, the closer that sound follows.
Closer still.
That is close enough.
Chasing you is more interesting.
I have no use for that.
You are not running.
I tip my head.
Stop asking that.
I keep walking forward.
There is no such thing.

lines.zh: 追逐的时候，我不停下来。
lines.en: While chasing, I never stop.

lines.zh: 追逐形态的我，笑了一下。
lines.en: In chase form, I smile once.
Run faster.
You dropped something.
I am standing on it.
It has gone cold.
This is refuse to me.
Will you come back for it?
I will not pick it up.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西，我绕着走。
lines.en: I walk around what you dropped.
You will come back for it.
Just as I would have it.
Keep moving.

lines.zh: 我的腿快过你听见的声音。
lines.en: My legs outrun the sound you hear.
Do you hear that sound?
I am at your back.
There is no one here.
How long can your legs last?
I need no aim.
I stay at your back.
I have taken your name.
Breathing is nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我把你的路线截成两段。
lines.en: I cut your route in two.
Do not look back again.
Now I have caught up.
I am still chasing.
Did you hear the laughter?
This distance is about to close.
Just this one.
I hold exactly this distance.
You slow, I close.
Your breath is shortening.
The road bends here.
I do not need the bends.
Your boots find the stones.
The door ahead shut.

lines.zh: 我的红影盖住你脚后的方块。
lines.en: My red shadow covers the block behind your feet.
That sound is always half a beat behind you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在墙间来回撞。
lines.en: Your footsteps bounce between the walls.
Your hand searches the wall.
The walls move on their own.
Your legs are failing.

lines.zh: 我就守着这段距离，你一慢我就近。
lines.en: I keep this distance; slow down and I close in.
That light ahead is not an exit.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和你的一模一样。
lines.en: My footsteps sound exactly like yours.
The gap has shrunk again.

lines.zh: 你听见喘气了吗？那是你。
lines.en: Do you hear panting? That is you.
Only this stretch left.
The road ends here.
I catch your shoulder.
One hit and you are down.
I waited long for that.
My fingers are far too long.
You are dragged back.
Still running?
I let you go once.
Now run again.
You are sweating.
I taste blood.
Run a little further.

lines.zh: 我把你按在石阶上，没用力。
lines.en: I pin you to the stone steps without effort.
I stay tight at your back.
I do not stop this time.

lines.zh: 我的手扣住你的背包带。
lines.en: My hand hooks your backpack strap.
This time I do not let you run.

lines.zh: 第二串脚步，踩在你的节拍上。
lines.en: A second set of steps lands on your rhythm.
I appear behind you.

lines.zh: 连虫鸣都被我压下去了。
lines.en: Even the insects have gone quiet under me.
I ran a long way to reach here.
On the road ahead, I am waiting.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底擦过方块，火星是红的。
lines.en: My soles scrape the blocks, throwing red sparks.

lines.zh: 我跑得比声音还快，别回头。
lines.en: I outrun sound; don't look back.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出三格，没出声。
lines.en: One stride covers three blocks, silently.
You have not started running.
Once I show, do not think of running.
You cannot see me, but I am here.
The moment I appear, I charge.

lines.zh: 已经非常近了，脚下的方块在响。
lines.en: Very close now; the blocks underfoot creak.
The chase has begun.
I am exactly where you turn to look.
This is the right moment.
I stop behind you.

lines.zh: 红色残影先拐过前面的墙角。
lines.en: A red afterimage rounds the corner ahead of you.
My red falls on the wall.
Then run.

lines.zh: 火照着我，我的影子更长。
lines.en: Fire shows me; my shadow grows.
My knees do not bend on landing.

lines.zh: 水下我跑不动，但水会退。
lines.en: I cannot run underwater. Water recedes.
The blast shoves me several blocks.
It passes through me.
That light slowed me an instant.
Hunger does not apply to me.
Lightning whites out the road.
There is no road to run here.
